sources.title: 10.29 release candidate scan, reviewed after raw preservation

claims.claim: All content and commerce data is delivered through /dwapi/ as JSON ViewModels to a decoupled frontend
A page, for example an item-typed BlogPost page, is retrieved by id from /dwapi/content/pages/{id}
The frontend app keeps URLs, logins, carts, language, currency, delivery country and impersonation state itself
Hosting options and frontend frameworks for the decoupled app

excluded.reason: Guidance on hosting and tooling, not a platform function with an acceptance criterion.

claims.claim: Username and password authenticate returns a JWT via GET or POST /dwapi/users/authenticate
Default JWT expiry is 1800 seconds and can be set per authenticate call
A JWT is refreshed before expiry with /dwapi/users/authenticate/refresh
Authenticated requests change prices, content, discounts and assortments; users, order history and favorites always need authentication
POST /dwapi/users/token exchanges a Dynamicweb.Extranet cookie for a JWT, lifetime up to 86400 seconds, 403 above the maximum
GET /dwapi/users/impersonatees lists users the token may impersonate; /dwapi/users/impersonate issues their token
External login provider configured active for frontend with callback URL and an email claim
External login completes with an Extranet cookie that is exchanged for a JWT in a headless frontend
Cross-domain token exchange needs CORS with credentials and a SameSite policy, or the popup pattern
External login callbacks are logged to the security log under ExternalAuthentication

excluded.reason: Diagnostic logging owned by the users and security area.

claims.claim: Create user over /dwapi/users/create
Password recovery for a user who is not logged in and password change for the current user
Address management for the current user
Update user information, PATCH partial and PUT full replace
Customer profiles: list and switch profiles that share one user name
Areas endpoint returns a website with its items
GridRows endpoint returns the rows of a page for a device
Navigation endpoint returns the tree for an area with ExpandMode, StartLevel, StopLevel and hidden or folder pages
Pages endpoint returns page metadata by id or URL
PageViews endpoint returns a full page with paragraphs and items
Paragraphs endpoint returns the paragraphs of a page
Translations endpoint returns design translations by design, area or culture
Get all forms and a form by id
Submit a form with its form token
Commerce endpoints take CurrencyCode, CountryCode and LanguageId context, plus OrderDate, StockLocationId and ShopId
Logged-in user context changes prices, discounts and assortment-scoped products
Products by group id, by query and repository name, or by product ids
Single product and variant by id with FilledProperties and PriceSettings.FilledProperties
Macros are unavailable in headless queries; use custom parameters
Carts created for anonymous users, the current user or an impersonated user
Carts on behalf of an impersonated user
Add products to cart by product number, order line type, fixed lines and custom prices
Update quantity, set shipping method, set payment method and complete the order
On-screen receipt from GET /dwapi/ecommerce/orders/{secret}; a completed cart is read as an order
Headless completion sends no confirmation mail; the Order Emails scheduled task sends it on its next run
GET /dwapi/query returns results for a repository query
Query results support paging and sorting
Query results include facet groups
Swagger documentation at /dwapi/docs and a Postman collection

excluded.reason: Developer tooling for exploring the API; no demo outcome.

claims.claim: A design folder under Files/Templates/Designs is connected to a website
Layouts and master templates wrap page content; a page gets its layout from the page, item type or website
Layout-specific folders and partials
Layout preview in the administration

excluded.reason: Editor convenience in the administration, not a frontend outcome.

claims.claim: Navigation rendered from NavigationSettings and NavigationTreeNodes, with secondary navigations, root nodes and expand mode
Administrators manage colors, fonts and buttons that generate CSS files and variables loaded by the design
Color schemes applied to rows and paragraphs by data attribute
Button styles generate CSS consumed by the design
Assets, CSS and JavaScript added to pages, build pipeline, fonts and asset deployment

excluded.reason: Frontend build practice; file deployment is owned by dw-setup-cli, not a ledger function.

claims.claim: GetImage parameters: size, crop modes, missing and alternative images, formats
Razor helpers ToGetImage, ToBackgroundStyle, focal points, ToSrcSet and ToSizesVW for responsive images
Paragraph template chosen per item type from the design Paragraph folder
Paragraphs in placeholders and grids
Apps (modules) attached to paragraphs, such as the Product Catalog
Row definitions, row settings and column widths of a grid
Row templates render a grid row from its definition
Rendering a grid from another page
Item type definitions stored as XML
Paragraph templates and page layouts chosen per item type
Item fields read in templates are not HTML-encoded
Extending ViewModels by subclassing or extension methods, including item-based ViewModels

excluded.reason: Custom C# extension code owned by dw-extend-csharp-api; a demo uses it only through a project that ships code.

claims.claim: Product Catalog for ViewModel app: index, spell check, display, list, details and compare templates
Feed template loaded when feed=true is in the URL on a catalogue page
Price, discount, before price and quantity price rendering in ProductViewModel templates
Rendering a matrix field

excluded.reason: Matrix fields are out of this snapshot.

claims.claim: Feed general settings, query, provider and mapping
Template, XML, JSON, CSV and Excel feed providers with options and attribute selectors
Feed details show an API Url per language, currency, channel and user
API keys generated in the backend with an optional expiry, shown once
Converting .NET Framework Razor helpers to .NET Core methods, with an AI agent option

excluded.reason: DW9 to DW10 upgrade task owned by dw-setup-upgrade.

claims.claim: Released addition: delivery.purchased-products-api. Evidence and measurement limits are in the 10.29.8 snapshot's delta-review.json.
Released addition: delivery.response-field-selection. Evidence and measurement limits are in the 10.29.8 snapshot's delta-review.json.
Legacy TemplateTags templates: no check yet. Its check (templatetags-in-use) has planned bindings only, so a build that requests it is UNVERIFIED.

gaps: TemplateTags: no DW10 developer documentation page was found; delivery.templatetags-templates rests on the skill only and stays candidate.

Service authorization: /dwapi/serviceauth/token is in the skill but not on the delivery documentation pages read; delivery.service-authentication stays candidate until the live /dwapi/api.json confirms it.
CORS: the administration setting that lists allowed origins was not located in the manual; delivery.cors-origin is candidate.

Favorites, loyalty points, internationalisation and order search endpoints are in the skill endpoint reference but not on the delivery documentation pages read; no functions here. Order search RetrieveMode belongs with commerce orders.

Referenced, not redefined: commerce.product-catalog-app, pim.feeds, content.layout-templates, content.navigation, content.forms, content.design-styles, assets.image-handler, swift.impersonation, users.external-login, orders.payment-methods, orders.shipping-methods, search.index-queries.

gaps.note: Release evidence is documented; its new behavioural binding is planned and cannot PASS.
